Overview

Social Media Management, explained

Customers check your social media to see if you're active, trustworthy and worth contacting. An empty or outdated page can quietly cost you business.

We plan, create and publish posts that match your brand, and look after comments and messages. You approve the content, and we handle the rest, with a monthly report on what's working.

Who it's for

  • Businesses that know they should post but don't have time
  • Brands with inconsistent or outdated pages
  • Businesses launching or rebranding
  • Owners wanting more engagement from existing followers

Why it matters

Why Social Media Management matters for your business

Before people visit a restaurant, book a service or buy a product, many check social media. An active, professional page builds trust; an empty one raises doubts.

Consistency is what makes social media work. Posting regularly keeps you in front of followers and helps the platforms show your content to more people.

We handle the planning, design, posting and replies, so your business stays active without taking your time. One restaurant client's reach grew from 900 to 2,400 in six weeks.

Pricing

What affects the cost of Social Media Management

  • How competitive your industry and keywords are
  • How many channels you want us to manage (search, ads, social, listings)
  • How much content and design you need each month
  • Your ad budget, which is always shown separately from our fee
  • Whether your website needs work before campaigns start

Every quote is itemised, in AUD or USD, and valid for 30 days.

Getting started

What we'll need from you

  • Access to your website, Google Business Profile and social accounts
  • Access to Google Ads, Meta Business Manager and Google Analytics, if you have them
  • Your logo, brand colours and any photos you'd like used
  • Who your best customers are, and which products or services you want more of

Don't have all of this yet? That's fine. We'll work through it together in your free consultation.

FAQ

Social Media Management questions

Which platforms do you manage?

Common choices are Facebook, Instagram, LinkedIn and Threads. We recommend the ones your customers use.

Is it included in plans?

It's in every bundled plan, or on its own as the Post & Grow plan.

Do we approve posts before they go live?

Yes. You review the calendar each month before anything is published.

Can you use our own photos?

Yes, and we encourage it. Real photos of your team and work perform well.

Do you run paid social ads too?

Yes, through our Google & Meta Ads service.

How often will you post?

It depends on your plan and audience. We'll recommend a schedule in your quote.

Do you create videos and reels?

We can create short-form content using your footage and photos.

Will you run promotions and competitions?

Yes. We can plan and run them as part of your calendar.
